items.title: Foreign ETFs Draw Nearly Double U.S. Large-Cap Flows
items.zh_title: 海外股票ETF九月吸金接近美国大盘ETF两倍
items.summary: The publisher RSS summary, citing FactSet's monthly ETF summary, says foreign-stock ETFs attracted almost twice the September inflows of U.S. large-cap funds; utilities and financials attracted assets while energy and industrials had the largest outflows. The article page was access blocked.
items.zh_summary: 发布者RSS摘要引用FactSet月度统计，称九月海外股票ETF流入接近美国大盘ETF两倍，公用事业和金融板块吸金，能源及工业流出较多。原文章页访问受阻，未核验统计宇宙与具体金额。
